_comment: Reader-prose content roots served by the local markdown viewer. `node viewer/serve.js` with no args discovers this file by walking up from cwd and serves every root namespaced (surveys/..., docs/..., ...). Records-style directories (prompts/ todos/ decisions/ bugs/) are intentionally excluded as non-reader content — they are an audit trail read through git and their INDEX.md files, not through the viewer. implementation/ is code, not prose. download/ temp/ node_modules/ and viewer/ are already excluded by serve.js's built-in defaults. Pass an explicit dir or --root to override; the public Cloudflare deploy is configured separately and stays surveys-only.
